title: Goemans–Williamson rounding bound
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $G$ be a weighted directed graph on $n$ vertices with nonnegative symmetric weights summing to $1$ and zero diagonal, and let $U$ assign a unit vector in $ rr^n$ to each vertex whose SDP value equals the SDP optimum. Suppose $	heta$ lies between the Goemans–Williamson angle and $\\pi$, inclusive, and $(1-\\cos\\theta)/2$ is at most the SDP optimum. Then the expected cut value from Gaussian rounding of $U$, with respect to $n$ independent standard Gaussian coordinates, is at least $\\theta/\\pi$.
